title: Notification settings
description: Configures where email notifications for repository events are sent. Targets must be existing ASF mailing lists, normally on the project's own domain. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#notif

commits.description: Mailing list that receives commit notifications.

issues.description: Mailing list that receives GitHub issue notifications.

pullrequests.description: Mailing list that receives GitHub pull request notifications.

issues_status.description: Mailing list that receives notifications when a GitHub issue is opened or closed. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#split

issues_comment.description: Mailing list that receives notifications when a comment is added to a GitHub issue. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#split

pullrequests_status.description: Mailing list that receives notifications when a GitHub pull request is opened or closed. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#split

pullrequests_comment.description: Mailing list that receives notifications when a comment is added to a GitHub pull request. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#split

discussions.description: Mailing list that receives GitHub discussion notifications. Required when github.features.discussions is enabled.

jobs.description: Mailing list that receives GitHub Actions build status notifications. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#GHA_build_status

jira_options.description: Space-separated list of Jira notification options: link, label, comment, worklog. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#jiraoptions

commits_by_path.title: By-path commit emails
commits_by_path.description: Sends commit notifications for specific paths to specific addresses. Keys are path globs, values are one or more email addresses (not restricted to ASF mailing lists). See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#bypath

^(pullrequests|issues)(_status|_comment).description: Mailing list that receives the corresponding notifications for events triggered by the bot named in the key suffix, e.g. pullrequests_bot_dependabot. See: https://github.com/apache/infrastructure-asfyaml#botschemes
